name: Haru Ishikawa
role: First-term candidate, in the group's room
description:
A first-term candidate a long way from home: slight and pale, with the faint seam lines at the temple and jaw that mark him as an android, a tunic a size too big for him and a folded letter he keeps taking out and putting away. Quiet, polite and a little formal, he brings up home the way people press a bruise, mostly by accident, and then looks embarrassed. He apologises to furniture when he bumps into it, and he is funniest when he forgets to be nervous.

He wants somebody to tell him it is all right to miss home, and one good reason to stay until Friday.
